articles.title: A-Level Results Are In! Here's What's Different This Year
articles.summary: Big news for UK teens: exam results just dropped, and more 18-year-olds than ever got into university. But fewer got their first choice. Here's what you need to know.

articles.title: White House Says Countries Are Sneaking Goods Past Tariffs
articles.summary: The Trump White House says countries are dodging US tariffs by shipping goods through other nations, costing up to $26 billion a year. China is the biggest offender, they claim.

articles.title: UK Hits Hottest Day of the Year at 38.1°C!
articles.summary: The UK just had its hottest day of 2026, reaching 38.1°C in London. Nurses are collapsing in hospitals without AC, and wildfires are burning. Europe is sweltering.
